lines.text: A muddy @dog_rex bounds through the park and leaps into @maya_front's arms, knocking her hat off.
Wide, then a whip pan to the catch.

new_beats.text: @maya_front laughs, mud smearing her cheek, and hugs @dog_rex tight.

writes.note: I kept your words and added a beat where Maya laughs and hugs the dog.

reply.rationale: The shot had the leap but no reaction, so one moment beat after the catch gives the payoff. Words and direction are unchanged.
